name: Estimate
description: An estimate — a proposal for a financial transaction (quote/bid) sent to a customer.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this Estimate object, assigned by QuickBooks. Required (system-defined) to reference the object for update, delete, and get operations.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Used for optimistic concurrency. Required in the body for update and delete operations to ensure the latest version is modified.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain of the entity; always 'QBO'. Response-only field.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Denotes whether the object is a sparse (partial) representation. Set true in an update body to perform a sparse update; appears in responses.

fields.name: CustomerRef
fields.description: Reference to the customer this estimate is for. Required to create an Estimate.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Customer object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced customer.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: The individual line items of the estimate. Each line has a DetailType discriminator that determines which *LineDetail object is populated.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Line item identifier, unique within the transaction. Required for sparse updates of an existing line; omit when adding a new line.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the line in the collection of lines.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form text description of the line item. Max 4000 characters.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Total amount of the line item. For SalesItemLineDetail, equals Qty * UnitPrice. Required for most detail types.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating which line-detail object is populated for this line.

attributes.name: SalesItemLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a sales item line (DetailType = SalesItemLineDetail).

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Item (product or service) sold.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced item.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class associated with this line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced class.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line (e.g. TAX or NON in the US).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: PriceLevelRef
attributes.description: Reference to the PriceLevel applied to this line. Reserved for future use by Intuit.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced PriceLevel.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced price level.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price of the item.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the item.

attributes.name: ServiceDate
attributes.description: Date when the service was performed.

attributes.name: TaxInclusiveAmt
attributes.description: The total amount of the line item including tax. Applicable to companies that use Automated Sales Tax (non-US).

attributes.name: DiscountRate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to this line. Mutually exclusive with DiscountAmt.

attributes.name: DiscountAmt
attributes.description: The discount amount applied to this line. Mutually exclusive with DiscountRate.

attributes.name: GroupLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a group of items (DetailType = GroupLineDetail).

attributes.name: GroupItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the group Item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced group Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced group item.

attributes.name: Quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the group item.

attributes.name: Line
attributes.description: The sub-lines (SalesItemLineDetail lines) that make up the group.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Sub-line identifier.

attributes.name: LineNum
attributes.description: Position of the sub-line.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Description of the sub-line.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Amount of the sub-line.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Detail type of the sub-line.

attributes.name: SalesItemLineDetail
attributes.description: Sales item detail of the sub-line.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Item sold on the sub-line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced item.

attributes.name: UnitPrice
attributes.description: Unit price of the sub-line item.

attributes.name: Qty
attributes.description: Quantity of the sub-line item.

attributes.name: DescriptionLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a description-only line (DetailType = DescriptionOnlyLineDetail). Carries no item; used for descriptive text or date-driven lines.

attributes.name: ServiceDate
attributes.description: Date the described service was/will be performed.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to a TaxCode for the description line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: SubTotalLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a subtotal line (DetailType = SubTotalLineDetail). Summarizes preceding lines.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the subtotal Item.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced subtotal Item.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced item.

attributes.name: DiscountLineDetail
attributes.description: Line detail for a discount line (DetailType = DiscountLineDetail).

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: Whether the discount is a percentage of the subtotal.

attributes.name: DiscountPercent
attributes.description: Discount percentage when PercentBased is true.

attributes.name: DiscountAccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the income account used to track discounts.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced account.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class for the discount line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced class.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for the discount line.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. Defaults to the current date if not supplied.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction (the estimate number). If not supplied and auto-numbering is on, QuickBooks assigns one. Max 21 characters.

fields.name: TxnStatus
fields.description: Status of the estimate transaction.

fields.name: AcceptedBy
fields.description: Name of the person who accepted the estimate.

fields.name: AcceptedDate
fields.description: Date the estimate was accepted.

fields.name: ExpirationDate
fields.description: Date by which the estimate must be accepted before it becomes invalid.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User-entered, private memo not visible to the customer. Max 4000 characters.

fields.name: CustomerMemo
fields.description: Message visible to the customer on the estimate.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The customer-facing memo text. Max 1000 characters.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Billing address of the estimate.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the address, assigned by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region/state/province within the country.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name.

attributes.name: Lat

attributes.name: Long

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Shipping address of the estimate.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the address, assigned by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address.

attributes.name: Line4

attributes.name: Line5

attributes.name: City

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region/state/province within the country.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code.

attributes.name: Country

attributes.name: Lat

attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address.

fields.name: ShipFromAddr
fields.description: Address from which products are shipped (origin address).

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the address, assigned by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region/state/province within the country.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name.

fields.name: ShipDate
fields.description: Date for delivery of goods or services.

fields.name: TrackingNum
fields.description: Shipping provider's tracking number for the delivery of goods.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the entire transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced class.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales Term associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Term.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced term.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: Custom fields (transaction-level) configured for the estimate.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the custom field definition.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: Name of the custom field.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: Data type of the custom field. Currently only StringType is supported for transactions.

attributes.name: StringValue
attributes.description: Value of the custom field when Type is StringType.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Sales tax information for the transaction as a whole.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the overall transaction TaxCode.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax code.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any tax lines manually inserted into the transaction line list.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Tax detail lines describing the taxes applied.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Tax amount for this tax line.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator for the tax line detail.

attributes.name: TaxLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail of the tax line.

attributes.name: TaxRateRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxRate applied.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxRate.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax rate.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: Whether the tax is percentage-based.

attributes.name: TaxPercent
attributes.description: Tax rate percentage.

attributes.name: NetAmountTaxable
attributes.description: The taxable net amount on which tax is computed.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method used to apply tax. Applicable to companies that use Automated Sales Tax outside the US.

fields.name: ApplyTaxAfterDiscount
fields.description: Whether discount is applied before tax is calculated (true = tax applied after discount).

fields.name: PrintStatus
fields.description: Printing status of the estimate.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email status of the estimate.

fields.name: BillEmail
fields.description: Email address to which the estimate is sent. Required if EmailStatus is NeedToSend.

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: The email address. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: BillEmailCc
fields.description: CC email address for the estimate (minorversion-dependent).

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: The CC email address.

fields.name: BillEmailBcc
fields.description: BCC email address for the estimate (minorversion-dependent).

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: The BCC email address.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts are expressed. Required if multicurrency is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: Currency exchange rate. Valid only if multicurrency is enabled. Number of home-currency units per transaction-currency unit.

fields.name: DepartmentRef
fields.description: Reference to the Department (location tracking) associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced department.

fields.name: ProjectRef
fields.description: Reference to the Project associated with this estimate (Projects feature; minorversion-dependent).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Project.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced project.

fields.name: ShipMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to the ShipMethod associated with the transaction.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced ShipMethod.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced ship method.

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Transactions linked to this estimate (e.g. invoices created from it).

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: Type of the linked transaction, e.g. Invoice.

attributes.name: TxnLineId
attributes.description: Line item Id of the linked transaction, when applicable.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction, including tax. Calculated by QuickBooks based on the lines.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: Total amount of the transaction in the home currency. Populated when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: Reference to the RecurringTransaction template from which this estimate was generated, if any.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced RecurringTransaction.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced recurring transaction.

fields.name: TaxExemptionRef
fields.description: Reference to the tax exemption identifier applicable to the transaction (Automated Sales Tax).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced tax exemption.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the referenced tax exemption.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive metadata for the object, maintained by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created (read-only).

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last modified (read-only).

specialOperations.name: Get an estimate as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified estimate as an Adobe PDF file formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) the estimate belongs to.

pathParams.name: estimateId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the estimate to retrieve as a PDF.

specialOperations.note: Returns binary PDF content (application/pdf), not JSON.

specialOperations.name: Send an estimate
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified estimate to the customer, sets EmailStatus to EmailSent, and populates DeliveryInfo with sending information.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm) the estimate belongs to.

pathParams.name: estimateId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the estimate to send.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Email address to send the estimate to; when supplied, Estimate.BillEmail.Address is updated to this value. If omitted, the existing BillEmail address is used.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit (POST .../send with no query param, sends to existing BillEmail) vs explicit (POST .../send?sendTo=<emailAddr>, overrides and updates BillEmail.Address).
